title: Braised Potato, Carrot and Onion
subtitle: in a date syrup sauce
description: A vegetarian potato stew with carrots and onion, spiced with paprika and ras el hanout and cooked in date syrup until deeply browned.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onions (cut into 2 to 3 cm cubes) and sliced garlic until golden. Add the potatoes (cut into 3 to 4 cm cubes), carrots and spices and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until the vegetables look glossy.

Add the date syrup and 1 cup water and bring to the boil. Cover and lower the heat. Cook for 40 minutes or until the potatoes are tender, the sauce has reduced and the whole dish is well browned. If the pot dries out and the potatoes are not soft enough, add more water (about half a cup at a time).
Serve hot, or keep in the fridge for 3 to 4 days and reheat over low heat before serving (add a little water before heating).
